train_loss: 0.5*CE(clean)+0.5*CE(noisy) with joint forward and original V5 noise schedule
selection: source clean F1 within 1pp of peak, then max five source noisy-val mean F1, tie clean F1 then earliest epoch
wd_adapter: two 64->64 k3 convs with BN; residual adds parameter-free identity; same parameter count as plain
resnet_encoder: reuse existing FivePhaseResNet1D stem/layers/pool/classifier exactly, normalize ONCE after harmonic shaping
